Config.description: Config describes one build document with stage order mod2schema -> mod2doc -> merge -> schema2json -> schema2doc -> schema2yaml.

check.description:
Check enables validation mode for all stages in the document.
When true, build compares generated outputs with existing files and fails on first mismatch instead of rewriting files. This is intended for CI to ensure generated files are up to date.

merge.description:
Merge applies import/patch actions over current `schema` file.
When both mod2schema and merge are declared, merge always runs after mod2schema. Use it to import shared definitions or patch fragments from other schema files.

mod2doc.description:
Mod2Doc renders documentation directly from the sibling mod2schema Go target.
Requires mod2schema in the same document and runs immediately after it. Uses raw Go comments by default and does not read the working schema or merge results.

mod2schema.description:
Mod2Schema reflects one Go type into JSON Schema and writes result to `schema`.
When declared, this stage always runs first. Use it when schema must be generated from source code before merge/export stages.

schema.description:
Schema is working schema path for the whole document pipeline.
`build` writes mod2schema output to this file, `merge` mutates this file in place, and schema2* stages read from this file as input. Use relative path for repository-local workflows, or absolute path for CI/temp directories.

schema2doc.description:
Schema2Doc renders documentation (list/table/html) from current `schema`.
Use this stage for user-facing reference docs committed to repository.

schema2json.description:
Schema2JSON generates JSON example payload from current `schema`.
This stage is useful for machine-readable fixtures and JSON examples in repositories, tests, and CI artifacts.

schema2yaml.description:
Schema2YAML generates YAML example payload from current `schema`.
This stage is useful for human-readable config examples and snippets.

indent.description:
Indent sets indentation width for one nesting level.
For `space`, this is number of spaces. For `tab`, this is number of tabs.

indent_type.description:
IndentType sets indentation character for pretty JSON.
`space` uses spaces. `tab` uses tabs.

minify.description: Minify enables compact one-line JSON output without indentation.

MergeImport.description: MergeImport describes one high-level definition import action.

conflict.description: Conflict sets behavior when target definition with same name already exists.

file.description: File is source schema path from which definitions are imported.

rename.description:
Rename configures how imported definition names are transformed.
Useful when source and target schemas use different naming conventions or when name collisions must be avoided.

source_defs.description:
SourceDefs selects source object used as definition map.
Import reads all direct child keys from this pointer and treats each key as one definition name to import.

target_defs.description:
TargetDefs selects destination object for imported definitions.
Use this when project keeps reusable definitions outside default `/$defs` or when imported definitions must be isolated under dedicated subtree.

MergeImportRename.description: MergeImportRename configures imported definition name rewrite.

mode.description:
Mode selects rename strategy.
- `none` keeps original names.
- `prefix` prepends `value`.
- `suffix` appends `value`.

value.description: Value is prefix or suffix text used by selected rename mode.

MergeOp.description: MergeOp configures merge strategy for one patch action.

array.description: Array selects array behavior for deep-merge operations. It controls whether arrays are replaced, appended, or appended uniquely.

node.description:
Node selects primary operation for target node.
- `replace` replaces target node with source node.
- `merge` deep-merges source into target.
- `merge-defs` merges fields of source object into target object.

object.description: Object selects object behavior for deep-merge operations. It controls whether source object members are merged or replace the target.

MergePatch.description: MergePatch describes one low-level merge action.

file.description: File is source schema path used by this action.

op.description: Op controls merge behavior for selected source and target nodes.

source.description:
Source points to source node in source schema.
Empty value means source schema root.

target.description:
Target points to destination node in working schema.
Empty value means working schema root.

MergeStage.description: MergeStage describes merge execution over working schema.

imports.description:
Imports lists high-level definition imports applied in order.
Each item imports entries from source defs object (for example `/$defs`) into target defs object in current `schema` (also usually `/$defs`). This is the convenient way to "pull shared type definitions" from other schema files without writing many manual patches.

patches.description:
Patches lists low-level merge actions applied in order.
Each patch copies or merges one source node from another schema file into current `schema`. Items are applied top-to-bottom; later patches can overwrite results of earlier patches.

prune_unreachable_defs.description: PruneUnreachableDefs removes unreachable `$defs` entries after merge.

Mod2DocStage.description: Mod2DocStage describes documentation generation directly from Go source.

comments.description: Comments selects Go comment normalization independently of mod2schema.comments. Empty means raw; source and other reflection settings come from mod2schema.

footer.description: Footer includes schemadoc version metadata in rendered documentation.

format.description:
Format selects embedded example format for doc template.
Empty value disables embedded example block.

hide_extra_keywords.description:
HideExtraKeywords disables "Other keywords" attribute row in rendered docs.
Internal keywords such as `x-order` are hidden regardless of this option.

json.description:
JSON configures embedded JSON example formatting.
Used when `format: json`.

list_marker.description: ListMarker controls unordered list marker normalization in rendered documents.

mode.description: Mode selects embedded example generation mode for doc template.

output.description:
Output is document output path.
When empty, build derives output from `schema` path and template metadata. Builtin list and table templates keep `.list` and `.table` suffixes; custom templates use their declared `output.extension` directly.

show_internal_keywords.description: ShowInternalKeywords includes renderer-specific schema keywords in rendered docs.

source_path.description:
SourcePath overrides the source path shown in document metadata.
It does not affect the working schema file or schema processing.

source_raw_path.description:
SourceRawPath overrides the raw schema URL shown in document metadata.
When empty, schemadoc derives the URL from SourcePath and the schema `$id` when possible.

template_file.description:
TemplateFile points to custom template file and overrides `template`.
Use this for project-specific layout and branding.

wrap.description: Wrap sets wrap width for plain-text description blocks.

yaml.description:
YAML configures embedded YAML example formatting.
Used when `format: yaml`.

Mod2SchemaStage.description: Mod2SchemaStage describes schema generation from one Go type.

comments.description: Comments selects raw Go comments or canonical plain text for schema descriptions.

json.description: JSON configures formatting of generated schema file.

jsonschema_version.description: JSONSchemaVersion overrides the pinned github.com/invopop/jsonschema helper version. The sibling mod2doc stage inherits this version and all source/reflection settings.

key_namer.description: KeyNamer controls fallback field-name strategy when struct field has no explicit `json` tag.

module.description:
Module selects reflection source.
Local mode: existing directory on disk with go.mod. Remote mode: module path with explicit version suffix (`@vX.Y.Z` or `@latest`).

package.description:
Package is import path where target type is declared.
Keep empty when type is declared in module root package.

root_id.description: RootID overrides the automatically generated root `$id` in the output JSON Schema. It must be an absolute URI without a fragment. Leave it empty to use the generator's default.

type.description: Type is root Go type name to reflect into schema.

type_namer.description:
TypeNamer controls external definition names; target-package types keep their names.
Package mode preserves package-base prefixes and rejects naming collisions. Full mode adds the sanitized full import path and a stable SHA-256 suffix. The sibling mod2doc stage inherits this setting.

Schema2DocStage.description: Schema2DocStage describes documentation generation from working schema.

footer.description: Footer includes schemadoc version metadata in rendered documentation.

format.description:
Format selects embedded example format for doc template.
Empty value disables embedded example block.

hide_extra_keywords.description:
HideExtraKeywords disables "Other keywords" attribute row in rendered docs.
Internal keywords such as `x-order` are hidden regardless of this option.

json.description:
JSON configures embedded JSON example formatting.
Used when `format: json`.

list_marker.description: ListMarker controls unordered list marker normalization in rendered documents.

mode.description: Mode selects embedded example generation mode for doc template.

output.description:
Output is document output path.
When empty, build derives output from `schema` path and template metadata. Builtin list and table templates keep `.list` and `.table` suffixes; custom templates use their declared `output.extension` directly.

show_internal_keywords.description: ShowInternalKeywords includes renderer-specific schema keywords in rendered docs.

source_path.description:
SourcePath overrides the source path shown in document metadata.
It does not affect the working schema file or schema processing.

source_raw_path.description:
SourceRawPath overrides the raw schema URL shown in document metadata.
When empty, schemadoc derives the URL from SourcePath and the schema `$id` when possible.

template_file.description:
TemplateFile points to custom template file and overrides `template`.
Use this for project-specific layout and branding.

wrap.description: Wrap sets wrap width for plain-text description blocks.

yaml.description:
YAML configures embedded YAML example formatting.
Used when `format: yaml`.

json.description: JSON configures output formatting for schema2json.

mode.description: Mode sets example generation mode (`all` or `required`).

output.description:
Output is output file path.
When empty, build derives output from `schema` path:
- schema2json -> `<schema-base>.json`

mode.description: Mode sets example generation mode (`all` or `required`).

output.description:
Output is output file path.
When empty, build derives output from `schema` path:
- schema2yaml -> `<schema-base>.yaml`

yaml.description: YAML configures output formatting/comments for schema2yaml.

YAMLCommentOptions.description: YAMLCommentOptions configures independent schema annotation comments.

defaults.description: Defaults enables comments sourced from schema defaults.

descriptions.description: Descriptions enables comments sourced from schema descriptions.

enums.description: Enums enables comments listing schema enum values.

example_format.description: ExampleFormat selects inline or block annotation value formatting.

examples.description: Examples selects scalar, all, or no schema examples.

spacing.description: Spacing selects compact or paragraph-preserving annotation comments.

titles.description: Titles enables comments sourced from schema titles.

YAMLOutputOptions.description: YAMLOutputOptions configures YAML output formatting and comments.

comments.description: Comments configures schema-driven comments above YAML keys.

indent.description: Indent sets YAML indentation width for one nesting level.
